items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 88:1
items.html:
(To the question) Reishaihu of Yeshsut [the head of Yeshsut]
The first Rosh of Yeshsut, which came out from the chest and above, is called Reishaihu of Yeshsut. See Answer 83. (p. 522, Item 45)
